$comment: boxPx, baselinePx, deltaE2000, ssimNonText and ssimElement are calibrated in M0 (docs/findings/m0.md §11). textInkDeltaE, textInkRatio and textInkCoverage are initial values to be calibrated by the fidelity suite; textInkRatio is the ink amount UI Toolkit draws relative to Chromium for the same text, measured on the M0 captures (light Inter text on dark backgrounds, 12-48 px, standard generator: 0.69-0.83); a line passes between textInkRatio x (1 - textInkCoverage) and 1 + textInkCoverage, and within textInkCoverage of the capture median ratio when the capture has 3 or more lines
